story.one: PureRoot Natural Foods was started with a simple belief: the food your family eats every day should be exactly what it says on the pack. Our spices are carefully sourced, naturally processed and packed to preserve their purity, flavour and goodness.
story.two: From everyday masalas to premium dry fruits, every product is FSSAI licensed, free from added colours and preservatives, and packed with care in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

reviews.title: Families who taste the difference.
reviews.lead: What our customers say about PureRoot spices and dry fruits.

one.name: Priya Sharma
one.text: The haldi has such a deep colour and fresh smell — you can tell nothing is mixed in. My dal and sabzi look and taste like my nani's kitchen again.

two.name: Rajesh Agarwal
two.text: Red chilli powder gives proper colour without making the food overly hot. No artificial red tint on the fingers like the loose masala from the market.

three.name: Neha Khandelwal
three.text: Ordered the walnuts for my kids' morning snack. Kernels were light, crunchy and not bitter at all. Very fair for this quality.

four.name: Vikram Singh Rathore
four.text: The garam masala aroma fills the whole kitchen. A small pinch is enough for a full pot of chhole. Will definitely reorder.

five.name: Anjali Mehta
five.text: Big, whole cashews — hardly any broken pieces in the pack. Used them for kaju katli at home and everyone asked where I bought them.

six.name: Suresh Choudhary
six.text: They replied quickly, confirmed everything and delivered to my shop on time. Good for bulk orders.

seven.name: Kavita Jain
seven.text: I soak the almonds overnight for the whole family. They are fresh, uniform in size and taste naturally sweet. The pouch keeps them crisp.

eight.name: Amit Gupta
eight.text: Dhaniya powder smells like freshly roasted seeds, not like dust. Glad to find a local Jaipur brand that is FSSAI certified and honest.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.lead: Can't find what you're looking for? We're one message away.

one.q: How do I place an order?
one.a: Add the products you want to your cart, then check out with your delivery address and pay securely online. You'll get an order confirmation straight away.

two.a: Yes. Our spices are ground from whole ingredients with no added colours, fillers or preservatives, and our dry fruits are packed as they are — the raisins have no added sugar.

three.a: Yes. PureRoot Natural Foods is FSSAI licensed — Licence No. 22226083000608.

four.q: Do you deliver to my area?
four.a: We ship from Dhawas, Jaipur. Enter your pin code at checkout to see the delivery options and timelines for your area.

five.q: Do you take bulk or wholesale orders?
five.a: Yes — for shops, caterers and bulk family orders, get in touch with your requirement and we'll share a quote.

six.q: How should I store spices and dry fruits?
six.a: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, and keep the pouch tightly sealed after opening to preserve aroma and crunch.
